blockingIssues.problem: Headline/general takeaway lacks the trial scope required by the evidence — the idea's title and implied lesson ('can backfire') present a general risk without naming the specific experiment or tested conditions, while the source is a single controlled test (Experiment 005) with three runs and explicit limitations on generality.
blockingIssues.correction: State the takeaway and title as specific to the tested trial and include key conditions and limits. For example: Title: "Experiment 005 — In this test, adding a generic 'Preserve Editorial Intent' rule shifted emphasis and introduced unsupported claims." Lead sentence / description start: "In Experiment 005 (three candidate runs, OpenAI gpt-5-mini, only Narrative.user.prompt changed), adding a generic 'Preserve Editorial Intent from the Synthesis' section caused the Narrative and Compose outputs to subordinate the company-level message, elevate orchestration, and introduce unsupported validation/audience framing; the candidate prompt failed promotion and production was restored. These results are limited to this tested prompt change and the recorded runs and are not proof of a general pattern." This smallest change ties the claim to the documented experiment and its limitations, matching the source's evidence and preserving the editorial purpose.
